artifacts.notes: Vatican web transcription of ASS 27 (1894-1895), pp.3-7, with a mechanically bounded correction of web-witness contamination. Exactly 1,440 bytes from the neighboring letter to Thomas Coconnier are excluded; every retained Litteras byte and its order are unchanged. The Legatus,/qui continuation, complete blessing, 2 July dating, subscription and six historical reference-note contexts were checked in the retained facsimile. The web delivery places those reference notes inline; their spelling and references remain literal. Boundary and note-membership inspection is not full word-for-word collation; remaining transcription/OCR defects are uncorrected.
artifacts.rights_basis: Historical Latin of Litteras a vobis identified in Acta Sanctae Sedis 27 (1894-1895), printed pp.3-7, including its address, complete body, blessing, 2 July 1894 dating and subscription. The retained facsimile title establishes publication by 1895. United States expired publication-term basis under 17 U.S.C. 304-305, with 104A remainder where applicable and 103(b) for unchanged preexisting wording. This bounded derivative excludes one exactly identified foreign-act insertion from the normalized Vatican web transcription; it does not clear portal HTML, modern bibliography, later revisions or translations. Shared authorities and jurisdictional limits: src/sources/inventories/papal-documents-rights-v1.toml. Historical source wording is excluded from Triptych CC BY 4.0.

Project-created exact byte-selection specification and source-ownership evidence are licensed CC BY 4.0; quoted historical Latin retains its separate United States public-domain basis and is excluded from that grant.
